Should I upgrade to Oracle JDK 8 if I am using IBM Mobile Foundation, IBM Worklight, IBM Worklight Foundation, or IBM MobileFirst Platform Foundation products?
An upgrade is available to replace Oracle JDK 7 with Oracle JDK 8. Do IBM Mobile Foundation, IBM Worklight, IBM Worklight Foundation, and IBM MobileFirst Platform Foundation products support the use of Oracle JDK 8?

source_lineage.excerpt: As stated on the Java SE at a Glance [http://www.oracle.com/technetwork/java/javase/overview/index.html] page, Oracle is automatically migrating users with the auto-update feature enabled from Oracle JDK 7 to Oracle JDK 8. However, a number of IBM and third-party dependencies for IBM Mobile Foundation, IBM Worklight, IBM Worklight Foundation, and IBM MobileFirst Platform Foundation do not support Oracle JDK 8.

For your apps to support iOS 9, download and install the latest interim fix from IBM Fix Central for your product. After you install the fix, update your projects and your Worklight Server or MobileFirst Server according to the instructions in the following PDF file: 

MobileFirst Platform iOS 9 support.pdf [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21966655&aid=2]MobileFirst Platform iOS 9 support.pdf [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21966655&aid=1] 

After you complete these tasks, your apps from IBM Worklight V6.0 and later, IBM Worklight Foundation V6.2.0, and IBM MobileFirst Platform Foundation V6.3 and later will continue to work on iOS 9 as they did on previous versions of iOS.
